visibility: Public RogNet/FixRelay campaign and experiments; no access tokens included.

experiments.label: H1
experiments.title: Four days of speed
experiments.hypothesis: Regularized regression can match the fixed SVM baselines using the original four speed measurements.
experiments.method: Fit Folds 1–3. Validate on Fold 4. Test ridge regularization, fixed linear/RBF SVMs, mean and persistence.
experiments.observation: Ridge RMSE 88.78 km/s versus 89.95 for the RBF SVM. Little trend skill (r = 0.070).
experiments.criteria: Match or improve the fixed SVM baseline.
experiments.candidates: 5 ridge penalties, 2 SVMs, and 3 simple references.

experiments.label: H2
experiments.title: Recurrence and in-situ measurements
experiments.hypothesis: History around 27 and 54 days, plus optional plasma and magnetic measurements, improves RMSE by at least 2%.
experiments.method: Compare ridge and small boosted trees with 34 speed features or 78 total features. Mask fitting measurements from held-out folds.
experiments.observation: Multivariate tree RMSE 74.83 km/s, a 15.72% reduction from H1. Recurrence alone accounts for most of the gain.

experiments.label: H3
experiments.title: GPU residual learning
experiments.hypothesis: A small residual neural network improves the augmented linear model by at least 2%.
experiments.method: 32/16-unit MLP, three fixed seeds, two weight decays, training-only scaling, early stopping and residual blends.
experiments.observation: RMSE 74.47 versus 75.15 km/s for the linear reference: 0.90% improvement, below the 2% threshold.
experiments.candidates: 6 neural fits; 5 residual blend weights per configuration.

experiments.label: H4
experiments.title: Average different model errors
experiments.hypothesis: A convex ensemble improves the accepted simpler selection rule by at least 1%.
experiments.method: 35 convex weight combinations across recurrence ridge, multivariate ridge/tree, and the residual neural ensemble.
experiments.observation: Half tree, half neural forecast reached 73.85 km/s. Gain: 1.31% over the accepted tree; 0.83% over the best single neural model.
experiments.criteria: At least 1% below the accepted rule, not below the best single model.

experiments.label: E5
experiments.title: Frozen original-holdout evaluation
experiments.hypothesis: The frozen selection rule improves untouched Fold 5 RMSE by at least 2% over short-history ridge.
experiments.method: Freeze the code, tune within each outer training set, retain all original test rows, and use 5,000 paired resamples of overlapping-block clusters. Match released WindNet predictions row by row.
experiments.observation: Lower five-fold mean RMSE (77.87 vs WindNet 80.28), but lower correlation (0.515 vs 0.550). Fold 5 favors WindNet (76.35 vs 78.06). The confidence interval against short ridge includes zero.
experiments.criteria: Point improvement plus uncertainty reported; no forced positive result.
experiments.candidates: 5 original outer holdouts; 2,198 matched forecasts; Fold 5 primary.

experiments.label: E6
experiments.title: Controlled feature ablations
experiments.hypothesis: Removing recurrence or in-situ covariate groups degrades the full multivariate ridge model.
experiments.method: Fix ridge model family, source masks, and evaluation rows. Retune penalty within the same inner fold for 10 feature variants.
experiments.observation: Removing the 27-day band costs 4.50 km/s; 54-day band costs 0.67; magnetic variables cost 0.21; removing plasma is essentially unchanged. Longer recent history alone does not help.
experiments.criteria: Report each component honestly, including negligible or negative additions.
experiments.candidates: 10 feature variants × 5 outer folds × 5 inner penalties.
